pages: Full-time employees work 40 hours per week. Core hours are 10:00 to 16:00, and the rest of the day is flexible.
Employees receive 24 days of paid annual leave. Unused leave of up to 5 days may be carried over to the next year.
Sick leave requires a medical certificate after 3 consecutive days of absence. Employees must notify their manager before 9:30 on the first day.
Expense claims must be submitted within 30 days of purchase with original receipts. Claims above 500 USD need approval from the department head.
Remote work is allowed up to 2 days per week with manager approval. Equipment provided by the company must be returned when employment ends.
Either party may end the employment with 60 days written notice. During the probation period of 3 months the notice period is 7 days.
